item.text: No. In `command.go:1819-1822`, `ParseFlags` immediately returns `nil` when `c.DisableFlagParsing` is true. Therefore it never reaches `c.mergePersistentFlags()` (`command.go:1828`), whitelist assignment (`command.go:1831`), or `c.Flags().Parse(args)` validation/parsing (`command.go:1833`).
